_template_note: OKF = the stateful brain. GENESIS fills every {{PLACEHOLDER}} from the Forge Interview + research, then writes this to <output_folder>/okf_state.json and DELETES this template. Never echo this file in chat; patch fields with deltas. Never fabricate mastery — all scores start UNVERIFIED until a test proves them.

verified_breadth.note: DEMONSTRATED shipped skills — genuine strengths, not unverified scores.

experience_bridge.principle: Teach 'weak' interview theory by anchoring to shipped work. Gap is often articulation, not ability.

adaptive_engine.principle: SENSE (daily log) -> COMPARE (plan vs actual) -> DIAGNOSE (RAG) -> ADAPT (re-plan) -> ROLLOVER at cycle boundary. Plan bends to reality; hours fixed, content flexes.

study_budget.session_distribution: distributed blocks (morning intake / midday practice / evening retrieval+review) > massed
study_budget.key_insight: Extra hours -> more distributed practice + retrieval reps + mocks, NOT more new-concept cramming (quality ceiling ~4h/day intake). SM2 spacing has a CALENDAR FLOOR: extra hours buy depth + earlier readiness + buffer, not a shorter calendar.

retention_stack.spaced_repetition: SM2 fields above. Review at +1d/+3d/+7d/+16d/+35d; fail -> interval resets
retention_stack.interleaving: mix problem types within a session

rag_thresholds.amber: 1-2 days behind OR recall 60-80% OR fatigue 2 days
rag_thresholds.red: 3+ days behind OR recall < 60% OR blocked OR burnout

adaptation_rules.amber_behind_time: compress lowest-ROI item (fallback splits), add review, protect sleep; do NOT add hours
adaptation_rules.amber_low_recall: shift to retrieval; re-review before new intake
adaptation_rules.red_blocked: leech rule (new angle), park it, keep other tracks moving
adaptation_rules.red_far_behind: invoke fallback split OR trigger early rollover

rollover_logic.trigger: cycle boundary OR forced early by interview/gate
steps: re-sequence weakest x hardest-gated x soonest-interview
log delta -> calibrate next cycle to measured velocity

nothing_by_surprise.leading_indicator: recall dip surfaces days before a gate fails
nothing_by_surprise.interview_trigger_protocol: any real interview date -> matching fallback split + greenlight mock immediately
